work_title: Make ErgoNodeViewHolder and its callers responsive with end-to-end backpressure (#1588)
description: Made ErgoNodeViewHolder and its callers responsive with end-to-end backpressure across ErgoNodeViewHolder (ModifiersFromRemoteProcessed and LocallyGeneratedModifierProcessed replies), ErgoNodeViewSynchronizer (bounded MaxInFlightViewHolderBatches = 32, deferred MessageProcessed, download throttling), PeerSynchronizer, NetworkController, PeerConnectionHandler (per-peer inbound message/byte limits with TCP SuspendReading/ResumeReading), BlocksApiRoute (POST /blocks ask backpressure), and CandidateGenerator, with unit and property tests (ergoplatform/ergo#1588). Upstream PR: https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2876.
